name: Credo Ventures

entity_kind.quote: Credo Ventures has closed Credo Stage 5, an $88 million fund raised in a single closing, continuing the Prague and Krakow firm’s fifteen-year strategy of writing the first institutional cheque for founders from Central and Eastern Europe and its diaspora.

investor_type.quote: Credo Ventures has closed Credo Stage 5, an $88 million fund raised in a single closing, continuing the Prague and Krakow firm’s fifteen-year strategy of writing the first institutional cheque for founders from Central and Eastern Europe and its diaspora.

sectors.quote: Sectoral focus is deliberately loose, Credo describes itself as founder-first rather than theme-driven, but the team is specifically attuned to technical founders with global ambitions, and has a growing eye on AI companies after the pace of growth in its fourth fund portfolio.

ticket_min.quote: Typical cheques will fall in the $1–5 million range, though Krikava told start-up.ro the firm remains flexible.

ticket_max.quote: Typical cheques will fall in the $1–5 million range, though Krikava told start-up.ro the firm remains flexible.

aum.quote: Credo Ventures has closed Credo Stage 5, an $88 million fund raised in a single closing, continuing the Prague and Krakow firm’s fifteen-year strategy of writing the first institutional cheque for founders from Central and Eastern Europe and its diaspora.

investments.quote: SuperPlane raises €2.28M in pre-seed funding led by Credo Ventures to build an open-source control plane for AI agents and production infrastructure.

notes: AUM is the size of the newest fund (Credo Stage 5, USD 88M, March 2026); the previous fund was EUR 75M (2022). Invests across CEE; SK included based on the CEE mandate and the older Photoneo seed deal, no 2025-2026 Slovak deal found. Participation in Supernova (Sep 2025) and Resistant AI is reported but no single quote names both.
